header.title: ERM Module Rebind
panel.module.label: 01 / Module
panel.module.title: Target module
panel.module.help: Paste the URI of the module in its change set context: https://<server>:<port>/rm/resources/<module id>?oslc_config.context=<change set URI>. The configuration context must be a change set. Project ID and the project name are then read from the module.
panel.excel.label: 02 / Excel file
panel.excel.title: Artifacts to rebind
panel.excel.help: Select the XLSX export of an ERM view. Row 1 must contain at least the columns id, Artifact Type, isHeading, parentBinding and module. The METADATA block added by the ERM export is ignored. An empty parentBinding places the artifact at the end of the module. A parent absent from the file is an anchor point: it must exist once in the module, and its children are added at the end of its chapter.
panel.rebind.label: 03 / Rebind
panel.rebind.title: Run
panel.rebind.help: Simulation ON (default): nothing is written, the structure before and after the change is downloaded for checking. Simulation OFF: after confirmation, the structure is written in the change set. A backup of the current structure is downloaded just before writing.
panel.report.label: 04 / Report
panel.report.title: Report
panel.report.help: Timestamped messages of the widget: file checks, processing report and errors. The zone is emptied at each run and each time a new file is selected.
